an3.34:1.3: Lobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, doso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, moho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an3.34:2.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ yatth' assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati,
an3.34:2.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭh' eva dhamme uppajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
an3.34:3.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave dosapakataṃ kammaṃ dosajaṃ dosanidānaṃ dosasamudayaṃ yatth' assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati,
an3.34:3.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭh' eva dhamme uppajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
an3.34:4.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave mohapakataṃ kammaṃ mohajaṃ mohanidānaṃ mohasamudayaṃ yatth' assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati,
an3.34:4.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭh' eva dhamme uppajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
an3.34:5.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave bījāni akkhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni sukhette suparikammatāya bhūmiyā nikkhittāni
an3.34:5.3: ev' assu tāni bhikkhave bījāni vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ.
an3.34:5.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yaṃ lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ . . . pe . . .
an3.34:6.1: yaṃ dosapakataṃ kammaṃ . . . pe . . . uppajje vā apare vā pariyāye;
an3.34:6.2: yaṃ mohapakataṃ kammaṃ mohajaṃ mohanidānaṃ mohasamudayaṃ yatth' assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha tam kammaṃ vipaccati,
an3.34:6.3: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭh' eva dhamme uppajje vā apare vā pariyāye.
an3.34:6.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya. 2.
an3.34:7.1: Tīṇ' imāni bhikkhave nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an3.34:7.3: Alobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, adoso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya, amoho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an3.34:8.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave alobhapakataṃ kammaṃ alobhajaṃ alobhanidānaṃ alobhasamudayaṃ lobhe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
an3.34:9.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave adosapakataṃ kammaṃ adosajaṃ adosanidānaṃ adosasamudayaṃ dose vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
an3.34:10.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave amohapakataṃ kammaṃ amohajaṃ amohanidānaṃ amohasamudayaṃ mohe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
an3.34:11.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave bījāni akkhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni
an3.34:11.4: masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya
an3.34:11.5: ev' assu tāni bhikkhave bījāni ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni,
an3.34:11.6: evam eva kho bhikkhave yaṃ alobhapakataṃ kammaṃ . . . pe . . . anuppādadhammaṃ:
an3.34:12.2: yaṃ amohapakataṃ kammaṃ amohajaṃ amohanidānaṃ amohasamudayaṃ mohe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ
an3.34:12.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya ti.
